_comment: v10 badminton match. Units: metres, seconds. Court 2 in the gym is centred at x=20, net at z=13; the player plays the near half (z > 13).

physics._drag: k = g / v_t^2 with terminal velocity v_t = 6.8 m/s: the shuttle slows sharply, so clears rise and then fall almost straight down

footwork._comment: rear-court footwork; see design-notes/v10.1. Times in s, distances in m.

en.front: No rear-court footwork at the front
en.late: Too late to set your feet
en.forehand: No need to turn on the forehand side

lines.intro_zh: 阿强：老师，我让您三分？……开玩笑的，来吧！
lines.intro_en: Ah Qiang: Shall I spot you three points? Kidding. Let's go!
lines.win_zh: 阿强：老师您这杀球……下周我还要来！
lines.win_en: Ah Qiang: That smash, Prof… I want a rematch next week!
lines.lose_zh: 阿强：承让承让！老师写基金太累了吧？
lines.lose_en: Ah Qiang: Thanks for the game! Grant writing wearing you out?
lines.rematchWon_zh: 阿强：上次输给您之后，我回去练了一周反手。
lines.rematchWon_en: Ah Qiang: After you beat me I practised my backhand all week.
lines.rematchLost_zh: 阿强：老师，今天还让我赢吗？
lines.rematchLost_en: Ah Qiang: Going to let me win again today, Prof?

wu.level_zh: 化学系博士后 · 校队

lines.intro_zh: 小吴：听说物理系请了教授出山。我不会手下留情的。
lines.intro_en: Xiao Wu: So physics sent a professor. I won't go easy.
lines.win_zh: 小吴：……好吧，物理系赢了。今晚的奶茶我请。
lines.win_en: Xiao Wu: …Fine, physics wins. Bubble tea is on me tonight.
lines.lose_zh: 小吴：化学系拿下！教授打得不错，就是步子慢了点。
lines.lose_en: Xiao Wu: Chemistry takes it! Good game, Prof — a step slow, though.
lines.rematchWon_zh: 小吴：上次是我状态不好。
lines.rematchWon_en: Xiao Wu: I was off my game last time.
lines.rematchLost_en: Xiao Wu: Back for more points?

autoWin._comment: win probability for 'just play it out' by opponent, interpolated on energy; filled from tools/bm_balance.js

lines_zh: 跑位是自动的，你只管出手。
上滑：高远球 · 下滑：吊球 / 放网 · 左右滑：平抽
球在头顶时点一下：杀球
脚下的圈收紧变绿时松手，就是完美时机。
电脑：W/S/A/D 和空格；体力越低，判定越窄。
lines_en: Movement is automatic: you only swing.
Swipe up: clear · down: drop / net shot · left/right: drive
Release as the ring at your feet closes and turns green.
Keyboard: W/S/A/D and Space. The more tired you are, the tighter the timing.
